task.description:
Write test specs and Playwright E2E tests for Stage F7 - Tenant Onboarding GUI (ONB-UI-01..04).

Read:
- docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md (## Stage F7 section)
- src/design/onboarding_gui.md (the validated design)
- docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md
- web/src/pages/admin/onboarding/ (the implemented pages)
- web/src/api/onboarding.ts

Write per-requirement spec files:
  tests/specs/ONB-UI-01.md
  tests/specs/ONB-UI-02.md
  tests/specs/ONB-UI-03.md
  tests/specs/ONB-UI-04.md

Write Playwright E2E tests:
  web/tests/e2e/onboarding/onb-ui-01.e2e.spec.ts  - nav entry visible for PLATFORM_ADMIN only
  web/tests/e2e/onboarding/onb-ui-02.e2e.spec.ts  - form validation and submission
  web/tests/e2e/onboarding/onb-ui-03.e2e.spec.ts  - progress polling lifecycle
  web/tests/e2e/onboarding/onb-ui-04.e2e.spec.ts  - result screen (success + failure + page-reload restore)

All tests MUST:
- Run against real backend (no mocks, no MSW)
- Use real Keycloak tokens via loginWithToken() helper
- Take a screenshot after every significant UI action
- Pass verdict as "screen shows X after Y" not "no error was thrown"
- Use per-test UUIDs for slug/hostname to avoid collisions
- Clean up: deactivate or delete any tenant created during the test

For ONB-UI-01: test that a non-PLATFORM_ADMIN user does NOT see "Register Tenant" in the nav.
For ONB-UI-02: test at minimum - required field validation, slug format validation, successful submit navigates to progress screen.
For ONB-UI-03: the saga runs asynchronously - test that the spinner appears after submit and that after completion the result screen is shown. Use a real POST to the onboarding API.
For ONB-UI-04: test the success view (slug + oidc_authority shown); the "Try Again" flow (navigates back with prefill); and page-reload restore via ?hostname=<h>.

Also check whether this is a sequential user journey requiring a pipeline test:
- ONB-UI-01 through ONB-UI-04 form a linear wizard (entry → form → progress → result)
- Create a pipeline test: web/tests/e2e/pipelines/onboarding-wizard.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts
- Create spec: tests/specs/PIPELINE-onboarding-wizard.md
- Add row to docs/guides/test_developer_guide.md §11.10 pipeline inventory

The pipeline test steps:
  pl.step('01: PLATFORM_ADMIN sees Register Tenant nav entry')
  pl.step('02: fill and submit registration form')
  pl.step('03: progress screen shows spinner')
  pl.step('04: saga completes - result screen shows slug + oidc_authority')
  pl.onCleanup() - delete the created tenant or mark it inactive

After writing all files, update the handoff:
- status: COMPLETED
- result.status: PASS
- result.summary: brief description
- result.artifacts_out: all spec and test files created
- result.issues: any deferred items
- result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR (Step 04b)
- completed_at: run python -c "import datetime; print(datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'))" and use exact output

Update handoffs/registry.json status to COMPLETED.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/ONB-UI-01.md through ONB-UI-04.md exist with GIVEN/THEN criteria
Playwright E2E tests exist for each of the four requirements
All tests use real backend (no MSW, no mocks)
pl.onCleanup() registered unconditionally in pipeline test

result.summary: Wrote 4 spec files (ONB-UI-01..04), 4 island E2E tests, 1 pipeline test (onboarding-wizard), and 1 pipeline spec for Stage F7 Tenant Onboarding GUI.

issues.description: onb-ui-01.e2e.spec.ts uses username task-worker-user/task-worker-pass for the non-PLATFORM_ADMIN test; actual Keycloak test credentials for a TASK_WORKER user must be confirmed against the test realm seed. If different credentials are used, update those two string literals before running.

onb-ui-04.e2e.spec.ts Try-Again test injects router state via page.evaluate + window.history.replaceState. If the React Router version does not pick up state from replaceState via PopStateEvent, the test will need to navigate normally through a real failed saga. Mark for verification during TEST-RUNNER execution.

Pipeline cleanup cannot delete the created Keycloak tenant realm because no DELETE /api/v1/admin/tenants endpoint exists in this version. The cleanup function logs the slug for manual purge. When the delete endpoint is implemented, update pl.onCleanup in the pipeline test.
